integrity_note: Analytic proof is supplied; numerical tests are finite diagnostics, not independent validation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Diagonal normal Fock composition symbols with strictly positive coordinate damping; no translations or nondiagonal generators. The second-order lattice formula is scalar only. Bibliographic priority for an older equivalent spiral optimization is not ruled out.
title: Sharp norm-jump and lattice-phase laws for rotating Fock composition semigroups
